document.name: Claim support
document.description: Compare a claim with supplied evidence, including contradictory or insufficient sources.

support.instructions: Does `source` support `claim`? Evaluate only the supplied source.

criteria.insufficient: The source does not establish either support or contradiction.

input.claim: Revenue increased in the second quarter.
input.source: Second-quarter revenue was $120 million, compared with $100 million in the previous quarter.

input.claim: The company will double revenue next year.
input.source: The company announced a new product. No revenue forecast was provided.

state.source: Second-quarter revenue was $120 million, compared with $100 million in the previous quarter.

document.name: Company news
document.description: Assess the reported business implications for a named company. This recipe evaluates the article, not future stock prices.

criteria.true: The named company or its operations are directly discussed.
criteria.false: The company is absent or only tangentially mentioned.

impact.instructions: What direction of business impact does the event in `article` suggest for `company`?

materiality.instructions: How material is the event described in `article` to `company`?

document.name: Email intent
document.description: Identify the main purpose of an email and whether the sender expects a timely reply.

intent.instructions: What is the primary purpose of `email`?

criteria.question: Seeking information.
criteria.complaint: Reporting dissatisfaction or requesting a remedy.

reply_requested.instructions: Does `email` ask the recipient to respond?

criteria.true: An explicit or implied request for an answer or confirmation.
A deadline or immediate-action request.

input.email: Can we meet Thursday at 2pm? Please confirm before tomorrow so I can book the room.
Here is our monthly product update. New features are available in your account. No action is needed.

document.name: Audience relevance
document.description: Check whether content fits an audience and whether it is promotional.
